```plain_text:updates.txt
6## [2025-01-29] Photo Upload System - Phase 1: Core Service & UI Components
- **MAJOR FEATURE**: Implemented foundational Photo Upload System including core service logic, UI components for photo selection and progress display, and initial offline queueing capabilities.

- **`PhotoUploadService.kt` Implementation**:
 - **Core Upload Logic**: Handles enqueuing, processing, and basic retry mechanisms for photo uploads.
 - **Image Preparation**: Integrates with `PerformanceOptimization.kt`'s `getCompressedImageBytes` utility for network-aware image compression before upload.
 - **Offline Queueing (Initial)**:
 - `SerializablePhotoUploadRequest`: Data class for serializing upload requests to disk (JSON via Gson).
 - Saves pending/failed requests to a local cache directory (`offline_photo_queue`).
 - Loads and attempts to resume queued uploads on service initialization.
 - Updates disk queue on status changes (progress, completion, failure).
 - **Progress Reporting**: Emits `UploadResult` via a `SharedFlow` to update UI on status and progress.
 - Uses blocking `ParseFile.save()` on IO dispatcher for simplicity in current phase; granular progress callback is a future enhancement.
 - **Target Object Linking**: Basic implementation to link successfully uploaded `ParseFile` to a specified `targetParseObject` and `targetField`.
 - Includes `UploadStatus.LINKING_FAILED` for cases where upload succeeds but linking fails.
 - **Cancellation**: Basic support for cancelling active uploads via `Job.cancel()`.
 - **Error Handling**: Manages upload failures, retries (up to 3 times with exponential backoff), and logs errors.

- **Photo Handling UI Components (`PhotoUploadComponents.kt`)**:
 - **`PhotoPickerDialog`**: Dialog for users to choose between gallery and camera.
 - Includes camera permission handling using Accompanist Permissions.
 - **`PhotoPreviewWithEdit`**: Dialog for previewing selected image (actual editing features are placeholders).
 - **`UploadProgressIndicator`**: Composable `Card` to display individual upload status, progress (simulated for now, then 100% on completion), error messages, and retry/cancel actions.
 - **`PhotoGridDisplay`**: `LazyVerticalGrid` to show multiple selected photo URIs with an "Add Photo" button.
 - **`PhotoUriHelper`**: Uses `FileProvider` for creating Uris for camera-captured photos (requires Manifest and XML setup).
 - **`PhotoUploadComponentsDemoScreen`**: Example screen to test and demonstrate the UI components and their interaction with `PhotoUploadService`.

- **FileProvider Setup**:
 - Added `<provider>` declaration for `androidx.core.content.FileProvider` in `AndroidManifest.xml`.
 - Created `res/xml/file_paths.xml` to define sharable paths (cache and external Pictures directory).
 - Added `<uses-permission android:name="android.permission.CAMERA" />` and `<uses-feature android:name="android.hardware.camera" android:required="false" />` to `AndroidManifest.xml`.

- **Enum Centralization & Build Fixes**:
 - **`AppEnums.kt`**: Created to be the single source of truth for `NetworkQualityLevel` and `ImageCompressionLevel` enums, resolving previous redeclaration errors.
 - **Dependency Management**: Added `com.google.accompanist:accompanist-permissions` and ensured `com.google.code.gson:gson` is correctly configured.
 - **Import Resolution**: Corrected imports for Gson, TypeToken, and Accompanist Permissions across relevant files.
 - **Linter Error Resolution**: Addressed various linter errors related to type mismatches, unresolved references, and enum usage in `PhotoUploadService.kt` and `PhotoUploadComponents.kt`.
 - **`ParseRestClient.kt`**: Temporarily commented out to isolate and resolve other build issues. Will be revisited.

### Next Steps for Photo Upload System:
- **Granular Progress Reporting**: Implement `ProgressCallback` with `ParseFile.saveInBackground()` for real-time upload progress.
- **Robust Offline Queueing**: Enhance `SerializablePhotoUploadRequest` and resume logic for more reliable re-fetching/re-linking of target `ParseObject`s.
- **Advanced Editing in Preview**: Integrate a third-party image editing library for crop/rotate features.
- **Full Screen Integration**: Integrate photo upload UI and service into all relevant screens (`FowlScreen`, `MarketplaceScreen`, `CulturalEventsScreen`, etc.).
- **Testing**: Thoroughly test photo uploads under various network conditions and with different image sizes/types.

(This update lays the groundwork for a robust photo upload system, crucial for many app features. Build is now stable after addressing enum and dependency issues, with ParseRestClient.kt pending.)
```

 ```kotlin
 // PhotoUploadService.kt
 class PhotoUploadService(private val context: Context) {
 private val dao = App.photoUploadDatabase.photoUploadDao()
 private val _uploadResults = MutableSharedFlow<UploadResult>(replay = 1)

 suspend fun enqueueUpload(request: SerializablePhotoUploadRequest) {
 val entity = PhotoUploadEntity(
 uri = request.uri.toString(),
 fileName = request.fileName,
 targetObjectId = request.targetParseObject,
 targetField = request.targetField,
 status = UploadStatus.PENDING.name,
 progress = 0,
 retryCount = 0
 )
 dao.insert(entity)
 uploadFile(entity)
 }

 private suspend fun uploadFile(entity: PhotoUploadEntity) {
 val parseFile = ParseFile(entity.fileName, getCompressedImageBytes(Uri.parse(entity.uri), context))
 withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
 parseFile.saveInBackground { progress ->
 val updatedEntity = entity.copy(progress = progress, status = UploadStatus.UPLOADING.name)
 dao.insert(updatedEntity)
 _uploadResults.tryEmit(UploadResult(toRequest(updatedEntity), false, null, null))
 }.continueWith { task ->
 if (task.isFaulted) {
 handleUploadFailure(entity, task.error.localizedMessage)
 } else {
 val completedEntity = entity.copy(
 status = UploadStatus.COMPLETED.name,
 progress = 100,
 fileUrl = parseFile.url
 )
 dao.insert(completedEntity)
 linkToTargetObject(parseFile, entity.targetObjectId, entity.targetField)
 _uploadResults.tryEmit(UploadResult(toRequest(completedEntity), true, null, parseFile.url))
 dao.delete(completedEntity)
 }
 }
 }
 }

 private suspend fun handleUploadFailure(entity: PhotoUploadEntity, error: String?) {
 val retryCount = entity.retryCount + 1
 val newEntity = entity.copy(
 status = if (retryCount <= 3) UploadStatus.RETRYING.name else UploadStatus.FAILED.name,
 retryCount = retryCount
 )
 dao.insert(newEntity)
 _uploadResults.tryEmit(UploadResult(toRequest(newEntity), false, error, null))
 if (retryCount <= 3) {
 delay(1000L shl retryCount)
 uploadFile(newEntity)
 } else {
 FirebaseCrashlytics.getInstance().recordException(Exception("Upload failed: $error"))
 }
 }

 private fun toRequest(entity: PhotoUploadEntity): SerializablePhotoUploadRequest {
 return SerializablePhotoUploadRequest(
 ```

package com.example.rooster

import android.content.Context
import android.graphics.Bitmap
import android.graphics.BitmapFactory
import android.net.Uri
import com.parse.ParseFile
import com.parse.ParseObject
import com.parse.ParseQuery
import com.parse.SaveCallback
import kotlinx.coroutines.*
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableSharedFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asSharedFlow
import java.io.*
import java.util.*
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap

// Simplified SerializablePhotoUploadRequest for Gson testing
data class SerializablePhotoUploadRequest(
 val id: String = UUID.randomUUID().toString(),
 val uriString: String,
 val fileName: String, // Added for clarity
 val targetObjectId: String? = null,
 val targetClassName: String? = null,
 val targetField: String? = null,
 val metadataJson: String = "{}",
 var statusName: String = UploadStatus.PENDING.name,
 var progress: Int = 0,
 var retryCount: Int = 0,
 var parseFileUrl: String? = null,
 var errorMessage: String? = null
)

// Main PhotoUploadRequest - used internally by the service for active uploads
data class PhotoUploadRequest(
 val id: String = UUID.randomUUID().toString(),
 val uri: Uri,
 val fileName: String, // From Serializable or generated
 val desiredCompressionLevel: ImageCompressionLevel? = null,
 var targetParseObject: ParseObject? = null,
 val targetField: String? = null,
 val metadata: Map<String, Any> = emptyMap(), // Deserialized from metadataJson
 var status: UploadStatus = UploadStatus.PENDING,
 var progress: Int = 0,
 var retryCount: Int = 0,
 var parseFile: ParseFile? = null,
 var errorMessage: String? = null
)

enum class UploadStatus {
 PENDING, QUEUED, UPLOADING, COMPLETED, FAILED, RETRYING, CANCELLED, LINKING_FAILED
}

data class UploadResult(
 val request: PhotoUploadRequest, // Use internal PhotoUploadRequest for results
 val success: Boolean,
 val parseFile: ParseFile?,
 val errorMessage: String?
)

class PhotoUploadService(private val context: Context) {

 private val uploadScope = CoroutineScope(Dispatchers.IO + SupervisorJob())
 private val networkQualityManager = NetworkQualityManager(context)
 private val gson = Gson() // Initialize Gson

 private val _uploadResults = MutableSharedFlow<UploadResult>()
 val uploadResults = _uploadResults.asSharedFlow()

 private val offlineQueueFile = File(context.cacheDir, "photo_upload_queue.json")
 private val MAX_RETRY_COUNT = 3
 private val activeUploadJobs = ConcurrentHashMap<String, Job>()

 init {
 if (!offlineQueueFile.parentFile.exists()) {
 offlineQueueFile.parentFile.mkdirs()
 }
 resumeQueuedUploads() // Will be adapted for Room later
 }

 // Temporary Gson-based queueing methods for validation
 private fun saveRequestsToDiskQueue(requests: List<SerializablePhotoUploadRequest>) {
 try {
 val json = gson.toJson(requests)
 offlineQueueFile.writeText(json)
 } catch (e: Exception) {
 // Log error, e.g., FirebaseCrashlytics.getInstance().recordException(e)
 }
 }

 private fun loadRequestsFromDiskQueue(): MutableList<SerializablePhotoUploadRequest> {
 return try {
 if (offlineQueueFile.exists()) {
 val json = offlineQueueFile.readText()
 val type = object : TypeToken<MutableList<SerializablePhotoUploadRequest>>() {}.type
 gson.fromJson(json, type) ?: mutableListOf()
 } else {
 mutableListOf()
 }
 } catch (e: Exception) {
 // Log error or handle corrupted file (e.g., delete it)
 offlineQueueFile.delete() // Simple handling: delete if corrupt
 mutableListOf()
 }
 }
 
 // Helper to convert SerializablePhotoUploadRequest to PhotoUploadRequest for processing
 private suspend fun SerializablePhotoUploadRequest.toPhotoUploadRequest(): PhotoUploadRequest {
 var targetObj: ParseObject? = null
 if (this.targetObjectId != null && this.targetClassName != null) {
 targetObj = try {
 withContext(Dispatchers.IO) { ParseQuery.getQuery<ParseObject>(this.targetClassName).get(this.targetObjectId) }
 } catch (e: Exception) { null }
 }
 val deserializedMetadata: Map<String, Any> = try {
 gson.fromJson(this.metadataJson, object : TypeToken<Map<String, Any>>() {}.type)
 } catch (e: Exception) { emptyMap() }

 return PhotoUploadRequest(
 id = this.id,
 uri = Uri.parse(this.uriString),
 fileName = this.fileName,
 // desiredCompressionLevel can be added if needed for resumed uploads
 targetParseObject = targetObj,
 targetField = this.targetField,
 metadata = deserializedMetadata,
 status = UploadStatus.valueOf(this.statusName),
 progress = this.progress,
 retryCount = this.retryCount,
 parseFile = this.parseFileUrl?.let { ParseFile("resumedFile.jpg", Uri.parse(it)) } // Simplified resumption
 )
 }

 private fun resumeQueuedUploads() {
 uploadScope.launch {
 val queuedRequests = loadRequestsFromDiskQueue()
 val stillPending = mutableListOf<SerializablePhotoUploadRequest>()
 queuedRequests.forEach { serRequest ->
 if (UploadStatus.valueOf(serRequest.statusName) != UploadStatus.COMPLETED &&
 UploadStatus.valueOf(serRequest.statusName) != UploadStatus.FAILED) {
 val requestToProcess = serRequest.toPhotoUploadRequest()
 processUploadRequest(requestToProcess, isResumed = true)
 stillPending.add(serRequest) // Keep in queue until success/permanent fail
 } else if (UploadStatus.valueOf(serRequest.statusName) == UploadStatus.FAILED && serRequest.retryCount < MAX_RETRY_COUNT) {
 val requestToProcess = serRequest.toPhotoUploadRequest()
 processUploadRequest(requestToProcess, isResumed = true) // Retry once on resume
 stillPending.add(serRequest)
 }
 }
 saveRequestsToDiskQueue(stillPending) // Save back only those still truly pending or retrying
 }
 }

 fun enqueueUpload(
 uri: Uri,
 fileName: String = "photo_${System.currentTimeMillis()}.jpg",
 desiredCompression: ImageCompressionLevel? = null,
 targetObject: ParseObject? = null,
 targetField: String? = null,
 metadata: Map<String, Any> = emptyMap()
 ): String {
 val metadataJsonString = gson.toJson(metadata)
 val serializableRequest = SerializablePhotoUploadRequest(
 uriString = uri.toString(),
 fileName = fileName,
 targetObjectId = targetObject?.objectId,
 targetClassName = targetObject?.className,
 targetField = targetField,
 metadataJson = metadataJsonString
 )
 
 val currentQueue = loadRequestsFromDiskQueue()
 currentQueue.add(serializableRequest)
 saveRequestsToDiskQueue(currentQueue)
 
 val internalRequest = PhotoUploadRequest(
 uri = uri,
 fileName = fileName,
 desiredCompressionLevel = desiredCompression,
 targetParseObject = targetObject,
 targetField = targetField,
 metadata = metadata
 )
 processUploadRequest(internalRequest)
 return internalRequest.id // Return ID of the active processing request
 }

 private fun updateRequestInDiskQueue(updatedRequest: PhotoUploadRequest, finalStatus: Boolean = false) {
 val currentQueue = loadRequestsFromDiskQueue()
 val index = currentQueue.indexOfFirst { it.id == updatedRequest.id }
 if (index != -1) {
 if (finalStatus && (updatedRequest.status == UploadStatus.COMPLETED || updatedRequest.status == UploadStatus.FAILED && updatedRequest.retryCount >= MAX_RETRY_COUNT) ) {
 currentQueue.removeAt(index)
 } else {
 currentQueue[index] = currentQueue[index].copy(
 statusName = updatedRequest.status.name,
 progress = updatedRequest.progress,
 retryCount = updatedRequest.retryCount,
 parseFileUrl = updatedRequest.parseFile?.url,
 errorMessage = updatedRequest.errorMessage
 )
 }
 saveRequestsToDiskQueue(currentQueue)
 }
 }

 private fun processUploadRequest(request: PhotoUploadRequest, isResumed: Boolean = false) {
 if (activeUploadJobs.containsKey(request.id) && !isResumed) return

 val job = uploadScope.launch {
 try {
 request.status = UploadStatus.UPLOADING
 _uploadResults.emit(UploadResult(request, false, request.parseFile, null))
 updateRequestInDiskQueue(request) 

 val imageBytes = prepareImageForUpload(request)

 if (imageBytes == null) {
 handleUploadFailure(request, request.errorMessage ?: "Failed to prepare image")
 return@launch
 }

 val parseFile = ParseFile(request.fileName, imageBytes, "image/jpeg")
 request.parseFile = parseFile

 parseFile.saveInBackground(SaveCallback { exception ->
 uploadScope.launch {
 if (exception == null) {
 request.status = UploadStatus.COMPLETED
 request.progress = 100
 if (request.targetParseObject != null && request.targetField != null) {
 try {
 request.targetParseObject?.put(request.targetField, parseFile)
 request.targetParseObject?.saveInBackground(SaveCallback { linkException ->
 uploadScope.launch {
 if (linkException == null) {
 _uploadResults.emit(UploadResult(request, true, parseFile, null))
 updateRequestInDiskQueue(request, finalStatus = true) // Remove from queue
 } else {
 request.status = UploadStatus.LINKING_FAILED
 request.errorMessage = "Linking failed: ${linkException.message}"
 _uploadResults.emit(UploadResult(request, true, parseFile, request.errorMessage))
 updateRequestInDiskQueue(request)
 }
 }
 })
 } catch (linkEx: Exception) {
 request.status = UploadStatus.LINKING_FAILED
 request.errorMessage = "Linking failed: ${linkEx.message}"
 _uploadResults.emit(UploadResult(request, true, parseFile, request.errorMessage))
 updateRequestInDiskQueue(request)
 }
 } else {
 _uploadResults.emit(UploadResult(request, true, parseFile, null))
 updateRequestInDiskQueue(request, finalStatus = true) // Remove from queue
 }
 } else {
 handleUploadFailure(request, exception.message ?: "ParseFile save error")
 }
 activeUploadJobs.remove(request.id)
 }
 })
 } catch (e: Exception) {
 if (e is CancellationException) {
 request.status = UploadStatus.CANCELLED
 _uploadResults.emit(UploadResult(request, false, null, "Cancelled"))
 updateRequestInDiskQueue(request, finalStatus = true) // Remove if cancelled
 } else {
 handleUploadFailure(request, e.message ?: "Upload exception")
 }
 activeUploadJobs.remove(request.id)
 }
 }
 activeUploadJobs[request.id] = job
 }

 private suspend fun prepareImageForUpload(request: PhotoUploadRequest): ByteArray? {
 return try {
 val compressionLevel = request.desiredCompressionLevel
 ?: networkQualityManager.getOptimalCompressionLevel()
 context.contentResolver.openInputStream(request.uri)?.use { inputStream ->
 val originalBitmap = BitmapFactory.decodeStream(inputStream)
 if (originalBitmap == null) {
 request.errorMessage = "Could not decode bitmap from URI"
 return null
 }
 val compressedBytes = getCompressedImageBytes(originalBitmap, compressionLevel)
 if (!originalBitmap.isRecycled) {
 originalBitmap.recycle()
 }
 return compressedBytes
 }
 } catch (e: IOException) {
 request.errorMessage = "File I/O error: ${e.message}"
 null
 } catch (e: Exception) {
 request.errorMessage = "Image processing error: ${e.message}"
 null
 }
 }

 private suspend fun handleUploadFailure(request: PhotoUploadRequest, errorMessage: String) {
 request.errorMessage = errorMessage
 request.retryCount++
 if (request.retryCount <= MAX_RETRY_COUNT) {
 request.status = UploadStatus.RETRYING
 _uploadResults.emit(UploadResult(request, false, null, errorMessage))
 updateRequestInDiskQueue(request)
 val backoffDelay = 2000L * (1 shl (request.retryCount -1)) // Corrected backoff for 2s,4s,8s
 delay(backoffDelay)
 processUploadRequest(request, isResumed = true)
 } else {
 request.status = UploadStatus.FAILED
 _uploadResults.emit(UploadResult(request, false, null, errorMessage))
 updateRequestInDiskQueue(request, finalStatus = true) // Mark as final fail, remove from active retry
 }
 }

 fun cancelUpload(requestId: String) {
 activeUploadJobs[requestId]?.cancel()
 // Also update the status in the disk queue if needed by finding and modifying the SerializablePhotoUploadRequest
 uploadScope.launch {
 val currentQueue = loadRequestsFromDiskQueue()
 val index = currentQueue.indexOfFirst { it.id == requestId }
 if (index != -1) {
 currentQueue.removeAt(index) // Or mark as CANCELLED and remove later
 saveRequestsToDiskQueue(currentQueue)
 }
 }
 }

 fun clearOfflineQueue() {
 uploadScope.launch {
 withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
 if(offlineQueueFile.exists()) offlineQueueFile.delete()
 }
 }
 }

 fun shutdown() {
 uploadScope.cancel()
 }
}

import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow

@Dao
interface PhotoUploadDao {

 suspend fun insert(request: PhotoUploadEntity)

 @Delete
 suspend fun delete(request: PhotoUploadEntity)

 @Query("SELECT * FROM photo_upload_requests WHERE statusName NOT IN (:completed, :failed) ORDER BY createdAt DESC")
 suspend fun getPendingRequests(
 completed: String = UploadStatus.COMPLETED.name,
 failed: String = UploadStatus.FAILED.name
 ): List<PhotoUploadEntity>

 suspend fun clearOldCompleted(
 completed: String = UploadStatus.COMPLETED.name, 
 beforeTimestamp: Long = System.currentTimeMillis() - 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000 // 24 hours ago
 )

 suspend fun getCountByStatus(statusName: String): Int
}

 ```kotlin
 // PhotoUploadService.kt
 package com.example.rooster

 import android.content.Context
 import android.net.Uri
 import androidx.room.Room
 import com.google.firebase.crashlytics.FirebaseCrashlytics
 import com.parse.ParseFile
 import com.parse.ParseObject
 import com.parse.ParseQuery
 import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
 import kotlinx.coroutines.delay
 import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableSharedFlow
 import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asSharedFlow
 import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
 import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream
 import android.graphics.Bitmap
 import android.graphics.BitmapFactory
 import android.provider.MediaStore
 import java.util.UUID

 data class SerializablePhotoUploadRequest(
 val uri: Uri,
 val fileName: String,
 val targetParseObject: String,
 val targetField: String,
 val status: String = "PENDING",
 val progress: Int = 0,
 val retryCount: Int = 0,
 val error: String? = null
 )

 data class UploadResult(
 val request: SerializablePhotoUploadRequest,
 val isSuccess: Boolean,
 val error: String?,
 val fileUrl: String?
 )

 class PhotoUploadService(private val context: Context) {
 private val dao = App.photoUploadDatabase.photoUploadDao()
 private val _uploadResults = MutableSharedFlow<UploadResult>(replay = 1)
 val uploadResults = _uploadResults.asSharedFlow()

 // Enqueue a new upload request
 suspend fun enqueueUpload(request: SerializablePhotoUploadRequest) {
 val entity = request.toPhotoUploadEntity()
 dao.insert(entity)
 FirebaseCrashlytics.getInstance().log("Enqueued upload: ${entity.fileName}")
 uploadFile(entity)
 }

 // Resume all pending uploads
 suspend fun resumeQueuedUploads() {
 val pending = dao.getPendingRequests()
 FirebaseCrashlytics.getInstance().log("Resuming ${pending.size} pending uploads")
 pending.forEach { uploadFile(it) }
 }

 // Update an existing request
 suspend fun updateRequestInDb(entity: PhotoUploadEntity) {
 dao.insert(entity) // REPLACE strategy handles updates
 FirebaseCrashlytics.getInstance().log("Updated upload: ${entity.fileName}, status: ${entity.status}")
 }

 // Cancel a specific upload
 suspend fun cancelUpload(requestId: String) {
 val entity = dao.getPendingRequests().find { it.id == requestId }
 if (entity != null) {
 dao.delete(entity)
 FirebaseCrashlytics.getInstance().log("Canceled upload: ${entity.fileName}")
 _uploadResults.emit(UploadResult(entity.toPhotoUploadRequest(), false, "Canceled", null))
 }
 }

 // Clear all offline queued uploads
 suspend fun clearOfflineQueue() {
 dao.clearCompleted("PENDING")
 dao.clearCompleted("UPLOADING")
 dao.clearCompleted("RETRYING")
 FirebaseCrashlytics.getInstance().log("Cleared offline queue")
 }

 private suspend fun uploadFile(entity: PhotoUploadEntity) {
 withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
 val parseFile = ParseFile(entity.fileName, getCompressedImageBytes(Uri.parse(entity.uri), context))
 parseFile.saveInBackground { progress ->
 val updatedEntity = entity.copy(progress = progress, status = "UPLOADING")
 updateRequestInDb(updatedEntity)
 _uploadResults.tryEmit(UploadResult(updatedEntity.toPhotoUploadRequest(), false, null, null))
 }.continueWith { task ->
 if (task.isFaulted) {
 handleUploadFailure(entity, task.error?.message)
 } else {
 val completedEntity = entity.copy(
 status = "COMPLETED",
 progress = 100,
 fileUrl = parseFile.url
 )
 updateRequestInDb(completedEntity)
 linkToTargetObject(parseFile, entity.targetObjectId, entity.targetField)
 _uploadResults.tryEmit(UploadResult(completedEntity.toPhotoUploadRequest(), true, null, parseFile.url))
 dao.delete(completedEntity)
 }
 }
 }
 }

 private suspend fun handleUploadFailure(entity: PhotoUploadEntity, error: String?) {
 val retryCount = entity.retryCount + 1
 val newEntity = entity.copy(
 status = if (retryCount <= 3) "RETRYING" else "FAILED",
 retryCount = retryCount,
 error = error
 )
 updateRequestInDb(newEntity)
 _uploadResults.tryEmit(UploadResult(newEntity.toPhotoUploadRequest(), false, error, null))
 if (retryCount <= 3) {
 delay(1000L shl retryCount) // Exponential backoff
 uploadFile(newEntity)
 } else {
 FirebaseCrashlytics.getInstance().recordException(Exception("Upload failed: $error"))
 }
 }

 private suspend fun linkToTargetObject(parseFile: ParseFile, targetObjectId: String, targetField: String) {
 val query = ParseQuery.getQuery<ParseObject>(targetObjectId)
 val targetObject = query.get(targetObjectId)
 targetObject.put(targetField, parseFile)
 targetObject.saveInBackground()
 }

 private fun getCompressedImageBytes(uri: Uri, context: Context): ByteArray {
 val bitmap = BitmapFactory.decodeStream(context.contentResolver.openInputStream(uri))
 return try {
 ByteArrayOutputStream().apply {
 bitmap.compress(Bitmap.CompressFormat.JPEG, 15, this) // Optimized for 2G
 }.toByteArray()
 } finally {
 bitmap.recycle()
 }
 }
 }
 ```

 ```kotlin
 // PhotoUploadService.kt
 package com.example.rooster

 import android.content.Context
 import android.net.Uri
 import com.google.firebase.crashlytics.FirebaseCrashlytics
 import com.parse.ParseFile
 import com.parse.ParseObject
 import com.parse.ParseQuery
 import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
 import kotlinx.coroutines.delay
 import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableSharedFlow
 import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asSharedFlow
 import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
 import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream
 import android.graphics.Bitmap
 import android.graphics.BitmapFactory

 class PhotoUploadService(
 private val context: Context,
 private val networkQualityManager: NetworkQualityManager
 ) {
 private val dao = App.photoUploadDatabase.photoUploadDao()
 private val _uploadResults = MutableSharedFlow<UploadResult>(replay = 1)
 val uploadResults = _uploadResults.asSharedFlow()

 suspend fun enqueueUpload(request: SerializablePhotoUploadRequest) {
 val entity = PhotoUploadEntity(
 uri = request.uri.toString(),
 fileName = request.fileName,
 targetObjectId = request.targetParseObject,
 targetField = request.targetField,
 status = UploadStatus.PENDING.name
 )
 dao.insert(entity)
 FirebaseCrashlytics.getInstance().log("Enqueued upload: ${entity.fileName}")
 uploadFile(entity)
 }

 suspend fun resumeQueuedUploads() {
 val pending = dao.getPendingRequests()
 FirebaseCrashlytics.getInstance().log("Resuming ${pending.size} pending uploads")
 pending.forEach { uploadFile(it) }
 }

 suspend fun updateRequestInDb(entity: PhotoUploadEntity) {
 dao.insert(entity) // REPLACE strategy handles updates
 FirebaseCrashlytics.getInstance().log("Updated upload: ${entity.fileName}, status: ${entity.status}")
 }

 suspend fun cancelUpload(requestId: String) {
 val entity = dao.getPendingRequests().find { it.id == requestId }
 if (entity != null) {
 dao.delete(entity)
 FirebaseCrashlytics.getInstance().log("Canceled upload: ${entity.fileName}")
 _uploadResults.emit(UploadResult(entity.toPhotoUploadRequest(), false, "Canceled", null))
 }
 }

 suspend fun clearCompletedUploadsFromQueue() {
 dao.clearCompleted(UploadStatus.COMPLETED.name)
 dao.clearCompleted(UploadStatus.FAILED.name)
 FirebaseCrashlytics.getInstance().log("Cleared completed/failed uploads")
 }

 private suspend fun uploadFile(entity: PhotoUploadEntity) {
 withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
 val parseFile = ParseFile(entity.fileName, getCompressedImageBytes(Uri.parse(entity.uri), context))
 parseFile.saveInBackground { progress ->
 val updatedEntity = entity.copy(progress = progress, status = UploadStatus.UPLOADING.name)
 updateRequestInDb(updatedEntity)
 _uploadResults.tryEmit(UploadResult(updatedEntity.toPhotoUploadRequest(), false, null, null))
 }.continueWith { task ->
 if (task.isFaulted) {
 handleUploadFailure(entity, task.error?.message)
 } else {
 val completedEntity = entity.copy(
 status = UploadStatus.COMPLETED.name,
 progress = 100,
 fileUrl = parseFile.url
 )
 updateRequestInDb(completedEntity)
 linkToTargetObject(parseFile, entity.targetObjectId, entity.targetField)
 _uploadResults.tryEmit(UploadResult(completedEntity.toPhotoUploadRequest(), true, null, parseFile.url))
 dao.delete(completedEntity)
 }
 }
 }
 }

 private suspend fun handleUploadFailure(entity: PhotoUploadEntity, error: String?) {
 val retryCount = entity.retryCount + 1
 val newEntity = entity.copy(
 status = if (retryCount <= 3) UploadStatus.RETRYING.name else UploadStatus.FAILED.name,
 retryCount = retryCount,
 error = error
 )
 updateRequestInDb(newEntity)
 _uploadResults.tryEmit(UploadResult(newEntity.toPhotoUploadRequest(), false, error, null))
 if (retryCount <= 3) {
 delay(1000L shl retryCount)
 uploadFile(newEntity)
 } else {
 FirebaseCrashlytics.getInstance().recordException(Exception("Upload failed: $error"))
 }
 }

 private suspend fun linkToTargetObject(parseFile: ParseFile, targetObjectId: String, targetField: String) {
 val query = ParseQuery.getQuery<ParseObject>(targetObjectId)
 val targetObject = query.get(targetObjectId)
 targetObject.put(targetField, parseFile)
 targetObject.saveInBackground()
 }

 private fun getCompressedImageBytes(uri: Uri, context: Context): ByteArray {
 val bitmap = BitmapFactory.decodeStream(context.contentResolver.openInputStream(uri))
 return try {
 val quality = when (networkQualityManager.getNetworkQuality()) {
 NetworkQualityLevel.POOR -> 15
 NetworkQualityLevel.FAIR -> 30
 NetworkQualityLevel.GOOD -> 50
 else -> 70
 }
 ByteArrayOutputStream().apply {
 bitmap.compress(Bitmap.CompressFormat.JPEG, quality, this)
 }.toByteArray()
 } finally {
 bitmap.recycle()
 }
 }
 }
 ```

 ```kotlin
 _uploadResults.emit(UploadResult(

 ))

 progress = progress,

 )
 updateRequestInDb(updatedEntity)
 _uploadResults.tryEmit(UploadResult(
 requestId = updatedEntity.id,
 isSuccess = false,

 progress = progress,
 error = null,
 fileUrl = null
 ))

 progress = 100,

 )

 ))

 }

 private suspend fun handleUploadFailure(entity: PhotoUploadEntity, error: String?) {
 val retryCount = entity.retryCount + 1
 val newEntity = entity.copy(
 status = if (retryCount <= 3) UploadStatus.RETRYING.name else UploadStatus.FAILED.name,
 retryCount = retryCount,
 error = error
 )
 updateRequestInDb(newEntity)
 _uploadResults.tryEmit(UploadResult(
 requestId = newEntity.id,
 isSuccess = false,
 status = newEntity.status,
 progress = newEntity.progress,
 error = error,
 fileUrl = null
 ))
 if (retryCount <= 3) {
 delay(1000L shl retryCount)
 processUpload(newEntity)
 } else {

 }
 }

 private fun getCompressedImageBytes(uri: Uri, context: Context): ByteArray {

 return try {

 NetworkQualityLevel.POOR -> 15
 NetworkQualityLevel.FAIR -> 30
 NetworkQualityLevel.GOOD -> 50
 else -> 70
 }
 ByteArrayOutputStream().apply {
 bitmap.compress(Bitmap.CompressFormat.JPEG, quality, this)
 }.toByteArray()
 } finally {

 }
 }
 ```

package com.example.rooster

import android.content.Context
import android.graphics.Bitmap
import android.graphics.BitmapFactory
import android.net.Uri
import com.google.firebase.crashlytics.FirebaseCrashlytics
import com.parse.ParseFile
import com.parse.ParseObject
import com.parse.ParseQuery
import com.parse.SaveCallback
import com.parse.ParseException // Explicit import for ParseException
import kotlinx.coroutines.*
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableSharedFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asSharedFlow
import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream
import java.io.IOException
import java.util.UUID
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap
import kotlin.coroutines.resumeWithException

// Serializable DTO for UI and enqueuing new uploads
data class SerializablePhotoUploadRequest(
 val id: String = UUID.randomUUID().toString(),
 val uri: Uri,
 val fileName: String,
 val targetParseObjectId: String, 
 val targetClassName: String, 
 val targetField: String,
 // val metadataJson: String = "{}", // If metadata is needed later
 var status: UploadStatus = UploadStatus.PENDING, 
 var progress: Int = 0,
 var retryCount: Int = 0,
 var errorMessage: String? = null,
 var parseFileUrl: String? = null 
)

// Internal representation for active processing (not strictly needed if entity is rich enough)
// For now, we will operate directly on PhotoUploadEntity within the service after conversion.

// Result DTO for UI updates
data class UploadResult(
 val requestId: String, 
 val status: UploadStatus,
 val progress: Int,
 val isSuccess: Boolean, 
 val errorMessage: String?,
 val fileUrl: String? 
)

class PhotoUploadService(
 private val context: Context,
 private val networkQualityManager: NetworkQualityManager // Pass NetworkQualityManager
) {
 private val dao = App.getPhotoUploadDao() // Use public getter
 private val _uploadResults = MutableSharedFlow<UploadResult>(replay = 1)
 val uploadResults = _uploadResults.asSharedFlow()
 private val uploadScope = CoroutineScope(Dispatchers.IO + SupervisorJob())
 private val activeJobs = ConcurrentHashMap<String, Job>()
 private val MAX_RETRY_COUNT = 3

 init {
 // Optionally resume uploads on service initialization
 // uploadScope.launch { resumeQueuedUploads() }
 }

 // Helper to convert UI DTO to Room Entity
 private fun SerializablePhotoUploadRequest.toPhotoUploadEntity(): PhotoUploadEntity {
 return PhotoUploadEntity(
 id = this.id,
 uriString = this.uri.toString(),
 fileName = this.fileName,
 targetObjectId = this.targetParseObjectId,
 targetClassName = this.targetClassName,
 targetField = this.targetField,
 // metadataJson = this.metadataJson, // if metadata is used
 statusName = this.status.name,
 progress = this.progress,
 retryCount = this.retryCount,
 errorMessage = this.errorMessage,
 parseFileUrl = this.parseFileUrl,
 createdAt = System.currentTimeMillis(),
 updatedAt = System.currentTimeMillis()
 )
 }
 
 // Helper to convert Room Entity back to UI DTO (SerializablePhotoUploadRequest)
 // This is used by UploadResult or if UI needs the original request structure
 private fun PhotoUploadEntity.toSerializableRequest(): SerializablePhotoUploadRequest {
 return SerializablePhotoUploadRequest(
 id = this.id,
 uri = Uri.parse(this.uriString),
 fileName = this.fileName,
 targetParseObjectId = this.targetObjectId ?: "", // Handle nullability if entity allows
 targetClassName = this.targetClassName ?: "",
 targetField = this.targetField ?: "",
 status = UploadStatus.valueOf(this.statusName),
 progress = this.progress,
 retryCount = this.retryCount,
 errorMessage = this.errorMessage,
 parseFileUrl = this.parseFileUrl
 )
 }

 suspend fun enqueueUpload(requestDto: SerializablePhotoUploadRequest) {
 val entity = requestDto.toPhotoUploadEntity().copy(statusName = UploadStatus.PENDING.name, progress = 0, retryCount = 0)
 dao.insert(entity)
 FirebaseCrashlytics.getInstance().log("Enqueued upload: ${entity.fileName} (ID: ${entity.id})")
 _uploadResults.tryEmit(UploadResult(entity.id, UploadStatus.PENDING, 0, false, null, null))
 processUpload(entity)
 }

 suspend fun resumeQueuedUploads() {
 val pendingEntities = dao.getPendingRequests() // Fetches non-COMPLETED/FAILED
 FirebaseCrashlytics.getInstance().log("Resuming ${pendingEntities.size} queued uploads")
 pendingEntities.forEach { entity ->
 if (!activeJobs.containsKey(entity.id)) {
 _uploadResults.tryEmit(UploadResult(entity.id, UploadStatus.valueOf(entity.statusName), entity.progress,false, entity.errorMessage, entity.parseFileUrl))
 processUpload(entity, isResumed = true)
 }
 }
 }
 
 private fun processUpload(initialEntity: PhotoUploadEntity, isResumed: Boolean = false) {
 if (activeJobs.containsKey(initialEntity.id) && !isResumed) {
 FirebaseCrashlytics.getInstance().log("Upload ${initialEntity.id} already active or completed.")
 return
 }

 val job = uploadScope.launch {
 var currentEntity = initialEntity
 var targetParseObj: ParseObject? = null

 try {
 if (currentEntity.targetObjectId != null && currentEntity.targetClassName != null) {
 targetParseObj = fetchParseObject(currentEntity.targetClassName!!, currentEntity.targetObjectId!!)
 // If targetParseObj is null here (and it's critical), might need specific error handling
 // or let it fail during linking. For now, proceed.
 }
 
 currentEntity = currentEntity.copy(statusName = UploadStatus.UPLOADING.name, progress = 0, updatedAt = System.currentTimeMillis())
 dao.update(currentEntity) 
 _uploadResults.tryEmit(UploadResult(currentEntity.id, UploadStatus.UPLOADING, 0, false, null, null))

 val imageBytes = getCompressedImageBytes(Uri.parse(currentEntity.uriString), currentEntity.fileName)
 if (imageBytes == null) {
 throw IOException("Failed to prepare image bytes for ${currentEntity.fileName}")
 }

 val parseFile = ParseFile(currentEntity.fileName, imageBytes, "image/jpeg")
 
 currentEntity = currentEntity.copy(progress = 50, updatedAt = System.currentTimeMillis()) 
 dao.update(currentEntity)
 _uploadResults.tryEmit(UploadResult(currentEntity.id, UploadStatus.UPLOADING, 50, false, null, null))

 // Perform ParseFile save using suspendCancellableCoroutine for better cancellation
 val saveSuccessful = suspendCancellableCoroutine<Boolean> { continuation ->
 parseFile.saveInBackground(object : SaveCallback {
 override fun done(e: ParseException?) {
 if (continuation.isActive) {
 if (e == null) {
 continuation.resume(true) {}
 } else {
 continuation.resumeWithException(e)
 }
 }
 }
 })
 // Cancellation for ParseFile.saveInBackground is typically not direct.
 // The job itself being cancelled will prevent further processing.
 // If Parse SDK offers a specific cancel for ParseFile upload, use it here.
 // For now, relying on job cancellation to stop subsequent steps.
 }
 
 if (!saveSuccessful) { // Should not happen if exception is thrown by resumeWithException
 throw RuntimeException("ParseFile save operation did not throw but returned false/null implicitly.")
 }

 currentEntity = currentEntity.copy(
 statusName = UploadStatus.COMPLETED.name,
 progress = 100,
 parseFileUrl = parseFile.url,
 errorMessage = null, // Clear previous errors
 updatedAt = System.currentTimeMillis()
 )
 dao.update(currentEntity)
 _uploadResults.tryEmit(UploadResult(currentEntity.id, UploadStatus.COMPLETED, 100, true, null, parseFile.url))

 if (targetParseObj != null && currentEntity.targetField != null) {
 linkToTargetObject(parseFile, targetParseObj, currentEntity.targetField!!, currentEntity.id)
 } else {
 // If no target or field, consider it fully processed after upload
 dao.delete(currentEntity) 
 FirebaseCrashlytics.getInstance().log("Upload ${currentEntity.id} completed (no target linking) and removed from queue.")
 }

 } catch (e: Exception) {
 if (e is CancellationException) {
 currentEntity = currentEntity.copy(statusName = UploadStatus.CANCELLED.name, progress = 0, updatedAt = System.currentTimeMillis())
 dao.update(currentEntity) // Or delete if cancelled items should be kept
 _uploadResults.tryEmit(UploadResult(currentEntity.id, UploadStatus.CANCELLED, 0, false, "Cancelled by user", null))
 FirebaseCrashlytics.getInstance().log("Upload ${currentEntity.id} cancelled by user.")
 // Decide if cancelled items should be deleted or kept with CANCELLED status
 dao.delete(currentEntity) // Example: remove cancelled from queue
 } else {
 FirebaseCrashlytics.getInstance().recordException(e)
 handleUploadFailure(currentEntity, e.message ?: "Unknown upload error", e)
 }
 } finally {
 activeJobs.remove(initialEntity.id)
 }
 }
 activeJobs[initialEntity.id] = job
 }

 private suspend fun handleUploadFailure(entity: PhotoUploadEntity, errorMsg: String, exception: Exception) {
 var currentEntity = entity.copy(
 retryCount = entity.retryCount + 1,
 errorMessage = errorMsg,
 updatedAt = System.currentTimeMillis()
 )

 if (currentEntity.retryCount <= MAX_RETRY_COUNT) {
 currentEntity = currentEntity.copy(statusName = UploadStatus.RETRYING.name)
 dao.update(currentEntity)
 _uploadResults.tryEmit(UploadResult(currentEntity.id, UploadStatus.RETRYING, currentEntity.progress, false, errorMsg, currentEntity.parseFileUrl))
 val delayTime = 1000L * (2 shl (currentEntity.retryCount - 1)) // Exponential backoff: 2s, 4s, 8s
 FirebaseCrashlytics.getInstance().log("Retrying upload ${currentEntity.id} (attempt ${currentEntity.retryCount}) in ${delayTime}ms. Error: $errorMsg")
 delay(delayTime)
 processUpload(currentEntity, isResumed = true)
 } else {
 currentEntity = currentEntity.copy(statusName = UploadStatus.FAILED.name)
 dao.update(currentEntity)
 _uploadResults.tryEmit(UploadResult(currentEntity.id, UploadStatus.FAILED, currentEntity.progress, false, errorMsg, currentEntity.parseFileUrl))
 FirebaseCrashlytics.getInstance().log("Upload ${currentEntity.id} failed permanently after ${currentEntity.retryCount} retries. Error: $errorMsg")
 // Failed uploads are kept in DB with FAILED status until cleared by clearCompletedUploadsFromQueue
 }
 }

 private suspend fun linkToTargetObject(parseFile: ParseFile, targetObject: ParseObject, targetField: String, originalRequestId: String) {
 var entityToUpdate: PhotoUploadEntity? = null
 try {
 targetObject.put(targetField, parseFile)
 val linkSuccessful = suspendCancellableCoroutine<Boolean> { continuation ->
 targetObject.saveInBackground(object : SaveCallback {
 override fun done(e: ParseException?) {
 if (continuation.isActive) {
 if (e == null) {
 continuation.resume(true) {}
 } else {
 continuation.resumeWithException(e)
 }
 }
 }
 })
 }

 if (linkSuccessful) {
 FirebaseCrashlytics.getInstance().log("Successfully linked ParseFile ${parseFile.name} to ${targetObject.className}/${targetObject.objectId}#$targetField")
 // Upload and linking successful, remove from queue
 entityToUpdate = dao.getById(originalRequestId)
 entityToUpdate?.let { dao.delete(it) }
 FirebaseCrashlytics.getInstance().log("Upload ${originalRequestId} fully completed and removed from queue.")
 } else {
 throw RuntimeException("ParseObject save for linking did not throw but returned false/null implicitly.")
 }

 } catch (e: Exception) {
 FirebaseCrashlytics.getInstance().recordException(RuntimeException("Linking failed for ${parseFile.name} to ${targetObject.className}/${targetObject.objectId}#$targetField: ${e.message}", e))
 entityToUpdate = dao.getById(originalRequestId)
 entityToUpdate?.let {
 val updatedEntity = it.copy(statusName = UploadStatus.LINKING_FAILED.name, errorMessage = "Linking failed: ${e.message}", updatedAt = System.currentTimeMillis())
 dao.update(updatedEntity)
 _uploadResults.tryEmit(UploadResult(updatedEntity.id, UploadStatus.LINKING_FAILED, 100, false, updatedEntity.errorMessage, updatedEntity.parseFileUrl))
 }
 }
 }
 
 private suspend fun fetchParseObject(className: String, objectId: String): ParseObject? {
 return try {
 withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
 ParseQuery.getQuery<ParseObject>(className).get(objectId)
 }
 } catch (e: Exception) {
 FirebaseCrashlytics.getInstance().log("Failed to fetch ParseObject $className/$objectId: ${e.message}")
 null
 }
 }

 suspend fun cancelUpload(requestId: String) {
 activeJobs[requestId]?.cancel(CancellationException("User cancelled upload $requestId"))
 // The job's cancellation handler (in processUpload) will update DB status to CANCELLED and remove.
 FirebaseCrashlytics.getInstance().log("Attempted to cancel upload: $requestId")
 }

 suspend fun clearCompletedUploadsFromQueue() {
 dao.clearOldCompleted(UploadStatus.COMPLETED.name) 
 dao.clearOldCompleted(UploadStatus.FAILED.name, System.currentTimeMillis() - 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000) // Clear FAILED older than 7 days
 dao.clearOldCompleted(UploadStatus.CANCELLED.name)
 FirebaseCrashlytics.getInstance().log("Cleared old completed, failed, and cancelled uploads from the local queue.")
 }

 private fun getCompressedImageBytes(uri: Uri, fileName: String): ByteArray? {
 return try {
 context.contentResolver.openInputStream(uri)?.use { inputStream -> 
 val originalBitmap = BitmapFactory.decodeStream(inputStream)
 if (originalBitmap == null) {
 FirebaseCrashlytics.getInstance().log("Failed to decode bitmap from URI for $fileName")
 return null
 }
 
 val compressionConfig = this.networkQualityManager.getOptimalCompressionLevel()
 val quality = compressionConfig.quality 
 val maxDimension = compressionConfig.maxDimension

 val resizedBitmap = if (originalBitmap.width > maxDimension || originalBitmap.height > maxDimension) {
 val ratio = minOf(maxDimension.toFloat() / originalBitmap.width, maxDimension.toFloat() / originalBitmap.height)
 Bitmap.createScaledBitmap(originalBitmap, (originalBitmap.width * ratio).toInt(), (originalBitmap.height * ratio).toInt(), true)
 } else {
 originalBitmap
 }

 ByteArrayOutputStream().use { baos -> 
 resizedBitmap.compress(Bitmap.CompressFormat.JPEG, quality, baos)
 if (resizedBitmap != originalBitmap) resizedBitmap.recycle() 
 originalBitmap.recycle() 
 baos.toByteArray()
 }
 }
 } catch (e: Exception) {
 FirebaseCrashlytics.getInstance().recordException(RuntimeException("Image compression failed for $fileName: ${e.message}", e))
 null
 }
 }
 
 fun shutdown() {
 uploadScope.cancel("PhotoUploadService is shutting down.")
 FirebaseCrashlytics.getInstance().log("PhotoUploadService shutdown.")
 }
}

Let's try the most explicit and standard form for `suspendCancellableCoroutine`:

**Standard Pattern for `suspendCancellableCoroutine`:**

```kotlin
val result = suspendCancellableCoroutine { <continuation_variable_name>: CancellableContinuation<Boolean> ->
 // 1. Define your callback
 val myCallback = object : YourSdkCallbackInterface {
 override fun onSuccess(data: YourDataType) {
 if (<continuation_variable_name>.isActive) {
 <continuation_variable_name>.resume(true) // or data
 }
 }
 override fun onError(error: YourSdkErrorType) {
 if (<continuation_variable_name>.isActive) {
 <continuation_variable_name>.resumeWithException(YourException(error))
 }
 }
 }

 // 2. Start the async operation with the callback
 sdk.startAsyncOperation(myCallback)

 // 3. Register the cancellation handler on the continuation
 <continuation_variable_name>.invokeOnCancellation {
 // Attempt to cancel the underlying SDK operation if possible
 // sdk.tryToCancelOperation(myCallback) 
 Log.d("Coroutine", "Cancelled")
 }
}
```

The key is that `invokeOnCancellation` must be called directly on the `continuation` object that is the parameter of the lambda passed to `suspendCancellableCoroutine`.

# Rooster Enthusiast App – AI-Driven Task Checklist

To help you develop your **Rooster Enthusiast App** efficiently using AI agents like GitHub Copilot, Back4App’s MCP (Multi-Cloud Prototyping), and Firebase Studio, I’ll provide a set of clear, concise, and effective prompts tailored to your app’s requirements. These prompts are designed to leverage AI tools for generating code, UI, and backend logic, aligning with your vision for a culturally resonant platform with community engagement, fowl traceability, marketplace, and order features. The prompts focus on simplicity and efficiency, targeting key tasks for your MVP in Kotlin with Jetpack Compose, Back4App (Parse) as the primary backend, and Firebase for optional features (e.g., Crashlytics, Vertex AI). I’ll organize prompts by module (Auth, Community, Traceability, Marketplace) and include guidance on how to use them with specific AI tools. Each prompt is crafted to produce actionable code or assets, minimizing manual refinement.

### Guidelines for Using Prompts
- **GitHub Copilot**: Use these prompts as comments in Android Studio (e.g., `// Prompt text`). Copilot will suggest code based on the comment and context. Ensure your project is set up with the Parse SDK and Jetpack Compose dependencies (as per previous artifacts).
- **Back4App MCP**: Enter prompts in the Back4App dashboard’s MCP interface or associated AI tool (e.g., Cursor, if integrated). Specify “Kotlin” and “Jetpack Compose” for Android compatibility.
- **Firebase Studio**: Use prompts in Firebase Studio’s App Prototyping or App Testing agent interfaces. Specify “Android” and “Jetpack Compose” for UI tasks or “Kotlin” for backend logic.
- **Best Practices**:
 - Be specific in prompts (e.g., include class names, fields, or UI components).
 - Review generated code for errors, especially for Parse queries or Firebase integrations.
 - Test generated code in a small scope (e.g., one screen) before integrating.
 - Use prompts iteratively, refining outputs as needed (e.g., “Add error handling to the previous code”).

### Prompts by Module

#### 1. AuthModule (User Authentication)
**Objective**: Implement user registration, login, and role management (Farmer/Consumer) using ParseUser.

1. **Prompt for Login/Registration UI (GitHub Copilot, Firebase Studio)**:
 ```kotlin
 // Generate a Jetpack Compose screen for user login and registration with fields for username, password, and a radio button for role (Farmer or Consumer). Include buttons for Login and Register that call ParseUser methods. Show error messages if authentication fails.
 ```

 ```kotlin
 .build()

 })
 ```

---

### How to Use Prompts Efficiently
- **Batch Prompts**: For large tasks (e.g., generating an entire screen), break into smaller prompts (UI, logic, data) to ensure accuracy.
- **Iterate**: If the generated code has errors, refine the prompt with more context (e.g., “Add error handling” or “Use coroutineScope for async”).
- **Validate**: Test each generated component in isolation (e.g., run `FowlActivity` to verify fowl addition).
- **Back4App Setup**: Ensure “Post,” “Fowl,” and “Listing” classes are created in the Back4App dashboard with appropriate fields.
- **AI Tool Selection**:
 - Use Copilot for real-time coding in Android Studio.
 - Use Back4App MCP for Parse-specific tasks (e.g., schema generation, Cloud Code).
 - Use Firebase Studio for UI prototyping or testing, especially if integrating Firebase features.

1. **Setup**: Update `build.gradle.kts` and `App.kt` with Back4App credentials (use previous artifacts).
2. **Authentication**: Use the `LoginScreen` prompt to generate `LoginActivity.kt`. Test login/registration.

@Composable
fun RoosterEnthusiastApp() {
 val navController = rememberNavController()
 val coroutineScope = rememberCoroutineScope()
 var userRole by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
 var error by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
 val snackbarHostState = remember { SnackbarHostState() }

 LaunchedEffect(Unit) {
 try {
 val currentUser = ParseUser.getCurrentUser()
 if (currentUser == null) {
 navController.navigate("auth")
 } else {
 userRole = currentUser.getString("role") ?: "general"
 }
 } catch (e: Exception) {
 error = e.message
 coroutineScope.launch {
 snackbarHostState.showSnackbar("Error fetching user role: ${e.message}")
 }
 }
 }

 userRole?.let { role ->
 Scaffold(
 bottomBar = {
 BottomNavigationBar(navController, role)
 },
 snackbarHost = { SnackbarHost(snackbarHostState) }

 else -> Text("Home Screen Not Available for This Role")
 }
 }

 composable("explore") { ExploreScreen() }
 composable("create") { CommunityFeedScreen() }
 composable("cart") { CartScreen() }
 composable("community") { CommunityScreen() }
 composable("dashboard") { DashboardScreen() }
 composable("transfers") { TransfersScreen() }
 composable("profile") { ProfileScreen(onLogout = { navController.navigate("auth") }) }
 composable("transferVerification/{orderId}") { backStackEntry ->
 val orderId = backStackEntry.arguments?.getString("orderId") ?: ""
 TransferVerificationScreen(orderId = orderId, onVerified = { navController.popBackStack() })
 }
 }
 }
 } ?: run {
 authScreen(navController)
 }

 error?.let {

 snackbarHostState.showSnackbar("Error: $it")
 }

 BottomNavItem("create", "Create", Icons.Filled.Create),

 )
 "farmer" -> listOf(
 BottomNavItem("home", "Home", Icons.Filled.Home),
 BottomNavItem("market", "Market", Icons.Filled.Store),
 BottomNavItem("create", "Create", Icons.Filled.Create),
 BottomNavItem("community", "Community", Icons.Filled.Group),
 BottomNavItem("profile", "Profile", Icons.Filled.Person)
 )
 "highLevel" -> listOf(
 BottomNavItem("home", "Home", Icons.Filled.Home),
 BottomNavItem("explore", "Explore", Icons.Filled.Search),
 BottomNavItem("create", "Create", Icons.Filled.Create),
 BottomNavItem("dashboard", "Dashboard", Icons.Filled.Dashboard),
 BottomNavItem("transfers", "Transfers", Icons.Filled.SwapHoriz)
 )
 else -> emptyList()
 }
 val navBackStackEntry by navController.currentBackStackEntryAsState()
 val currentRoute = navBackStackEntry?.destination?.route
 NavigationBar {
 items.forEach { item ->
 NavigationBarItem(
 icon = { Icon(item.icon, contentDescription = item.label) },
 label = { Text(item.label) },
 selected = currentRoute == item.route,
 onClick = {
 if (currentRoute != item.route) {
 navController.navigate(item.route) {
 popUpTo(navController.graph.startDestinationId) { inclusive = false }
 launchSingleTop = true
 }
 }
 }
 )
 }
 }
}

data class Alert(val message: String, val createdAt: String)
data class Product(val title: String, val price: Int)
data class SocialPost(val username: String, val content: String)

suspend fun fetchAlerts(
 onResult: (List<Alert>) -> Unit,
 onError: (String?) -> Unit,
 setLoading: (Boolean) -> Unit
) {
 setLoading(true)
 try {
 val query = ParseQuery.getQuery<ParseObject>("Notification")
 query.whereEqualTo("user", ParseUser.getCurrentUser())
 query.orderByDescending("createdAt")
 query.limit = 5
 val results = query.find()
 onResult(results.mapNotNull {
 val message = it.getString("message") ?: return@mapNotNull null
 val createdAt = it.createdAt?.toString() ?: return@mapNotNull null
 Alert(message, createdAt)
 })
 } catch (e: Exception) {
 onError(e.message)
 } finally {
 setLoading(false)
 }
}

suspend fun fetchProducts(
 onResult: (List<Product>) -> Unit,
 onError: (String?) -> Unit,
 setLoading: (Boolean) -> Unit
) {
 setLoading(true)
 try {
 val query = ParseQuery.getQuery<ParseObject>("Listing")
 query.whereEqualTo("seller", ParseUser.getCurrentUser())
 query.orderByDescending("createdAt")
 query.limit = 5
 val results = query.find()
 onResult(results.mapNotNull {
 val title = it.getString("title") ?: return@mapNotNull null
 val price = it.getInt("price")
 Product(title, price)
 })
 } catch (e: Exception) {
 onError(e.message)
 } finally {
 setLoading(false)
 }
}

suspend fun fetchSocialPosts(
 onResult: (List<SocialPost>) -> Unit,
 onError: (String?) -> Unit,
 setLoading: (Boolean) -> Unit
) {
 setLoading(true)
 try {
 val query = ParseQuery.getQuery<ParseObject>("Post")
 query.include("user")
 query.orderByDescending("createdAt")
 query.limit = 5
 val results = query.find()
 onResult(results.mapNotNull {
 val user = it.getParseUser("user") ?: return@mapNotNull null
 val username = user.getString("username") ?: return@mapNotNull null
 val content = it.getString("content") ?: return@mapNotNull null
 SocialPost(username, content)
 })
 } catch (e: Exception) {
 onError(e.message)
 } finally {
 setLoading(false)
 }
}

```plain_text:updates.txt
## [2025-05-23] MCP Servers Integration & AI-Driven Workflow Guidance

### MCP Server Integration
- Integrated multiple Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers in `.config/github-copilot/intellij/mcp.json` to enhance development:
 - Playwright MCP: Browser/UI automation and testing
 - Context7 MCP: Natural language to code/UI generation
 - Awesome Linters: Curated linter/code quality reference
 - Sequential Thinking MCP: Step-by-step debugging and structured problem solving
 - Memory Bank MCP: Store/retrieve code, logs, and project memory
 - Steel Puppeteer MCP: Browser/emulator automation and screenshotting
 - Knowledge Graph Memory MCP: Persistent memory and relationship management
 - MCP Compass: Discovery and recommendation of MCP servers
 - DuckDuckGo Search MCP: Web search for documentation and solutions

### How to Use MCPs in Rooster App Development
- **Fix Build Errors**: Use context7 and sequential-thinking MCPs to generate/fix Jetpack Compose code and debug errors in files like `MainActivity.kt`.
- **Preview UI**: Use @Preview annotations in Compose, and automate emulator UI tests/screenshots with playwright or steel-puppeteer MCPs.
- **Lint and Format**: Reference awesome-linters and use tools like ktlint for code quality.
- **Store Progress**: Use memory-bank MCP to archive fixed code and build logs for future reference.
- **Validate Data**: Use Back4App dashboard for Parse data, and knowledge-graph-memory MCP for lineage/traceability previews.
- **Find Documentation**: Use duckduckgo-search MCP to quickly search for solutions to errors or implementation questions.
- **Get Recommendations**: Use mcp-compass MCP to discover the best MCP for a given task (e.g., UI prototyping, debugging).

### Example Prompts for AI Agents
- Generate/fix Compose code: `context7` MCP prompt for MainActivity.kt with BottomNavigation and navigation.
- Automate UI tests: `playwright` or `steel-puppeteer` MCP prompt to click tabs and screenshot screens.
- Lint code: Use `ktlint` as referenced by awesome-linters.
- Debug errors: `sequential-thinking` MCP prompt for stepwise build error resolution.
- Store/retrieve code: `memory-bank` MCP prompt to save MainActivity.kt and logs.
- Preview data relationships: `knowledge-graph-memory` MCP prompt for fowl lineage.
- Search for docs: `duckduckgo-search` MCP prompt for Compose navigation errors.
- Get tool recommendations: `mcp-compass` MCP prompt for UI or debugging tasks.

### Next Steps
- Review `.config/github-copilot/intellij/mcp.json` for available MCP servers and their descriptions.
- Use the mapped prompts and tools above to accelerate development, fix errors, and enable robust previews.
```

```
+ return try {
```

```
+ } catch (e: Exception) {
+ emptyList()
+ }

+private suspend fun fetchUserFowls(): List<ParseObject> {

+ query.limit = 10
+ return try {
+ query.find()
+ } catch (e: Exception) {
+ emptyList()
+ }
+}
```

```plain_text:updates.txt
## [2025-05-23] MCP Servers Integration & AI-Driven Workflow Guidance

### MCP Server Integration
- Integrated multiple Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers in `.config/github-copilot/intellij/mcp.json` to enhance development:
 - Playwright MCP: Browser/UI automation and testing
 - Context7 MCP: Natural language to code/UI generation
 - Awesome Linters: Curated linter/code quality reference
 - Sequential Thinking MCP: Step-by-step debugging and structured problem solving
 - Memory Bank MCP: Store/retrieve code, logs, and project memory
 - Steel Puppeteer MCP: Browser/emulator automation and screenshotting
 - Knowledge Graph Memory MCP: Persistent memory and relationship management
 - MCP Compass: Discovery and recommendation of MCP servers
 - DuckDuckGo Search MCP: Web search for documentation and solutions

### How to Use MCPs in Rooster App Development
- **Fix Build Errors**: Use context7 and sequential-thinking MCPs to generate/fix Jetpack Compose code and debug errors in files like `MainActivity.kt`.
- **Preview UI**: Use @Preview annotations in Compose, and automate emulator UI tests/screenshots with playwright or steel-puppeteer MCPs.
- **Lint and Format**: Reference awesome-linters and use tools like ktlint for code quality.
- **Store Progress**: Use memory-bank MCP to archive fixed code and build logs for future reference.
- **Validate Data**: Use Back4App dashboard for Parse data, and knowledge-graph-memory MCP for lineage/traceability previews.
- **Find Documentation**: Use duckduckgo-search MCP to quickly search for solutions to errors or implementation questions.
- **Get Recommendations**: Use mcp-compass MCP to discover the best MCP for a given task (e.g., UI prototyping, debugging).

### Example Prompts for AI Agents
- Generate/fix Compose code: `context7` MCP prompt for MainActivity.kt with BottomNavigation and navigation.
- Automate UI tests: `playwright` or `steel-puppeteer` MCP prompt to click tabs and screenshot screens.
- Lint code: Use `ktlint` as referenced by awesome-linters.
- Debug errors: `sequential-thinking` MCP prompt for stepwise build error resolution.
- Store/retrieve code: `memory-bank` MCP prompt to save MainActivity.kt and logs.
- Preview data relationships: `knowledge-graph-memory` MCP prompt for fowl lineage.
- Search for docs: `duckduckgo-search` MCP prompt for Compose navigation errors.
- Get tool recommendations: `mcp-compass` MCP prompt for UI or debugging tasks.
```

```kotlin
data class PostData(
 val objectId: String,
 val content: String,
 val username: String,
 val imageUrl: String?,
 val likes: Int,
 val comments: List<String>
)

suspend fun fetchPosts(posts: MutableState<List<PostData>>, isLoading: MutableState<Boolean>, error: MutableState<String?>) {
 isLoading.value = true
 try {
 val query = ParseQuery.getQuery<ParseObject>("Post")
 query.setLimit(20)
 query.orderByDescending("createdAt")
 query.include("user")
 val results = query.find()
 posts.value = results.mapNotNull {
 val content = it.getString("content")
 val user = it.getParseUser("user")?.username
 val image = it.getParseFile("image")?.url
 val likes = it.getInt("likes") ?: 0
 val comments = it.getList<String>("comments") ?: emptyList()
 if (content != null && user != null) {
 PostData(it.objectId, content, user, image, likes, comments)
 } else null
 }
 } catch (e: Exception) {
 error.value = e.message
 } finally {
 isLoading.value = false
 }
}

fun compressImage(context: Context, uri: Uri): ByteArray? {
 return try {
 val inputStream = context.contentResolver.openInputStream(uri)
 val bitmap = BitmapFactory.decodeStream(inputStream)
 val outputStream = ByteArrayOutputStream()
 bitmap.compress(Bitmap.CompressFormat.JPEG, 80, outputStream)
 outputStream.toByteArray()
 } catch (e: Exception) {
 Log.e("ImageCompression", "Error compressing image", e)
 null
 }
}
```

```plain_text:updates.txt
## [2025-05-23] MCP Servers Integration & AI-Driven Workflow Guidance

### MCP Server Integration
- Integrated multiple Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers in `.config/github-copilot/intellij/mcp.json` to enhance development:
 - Playwright MCP: Browser/UI automation and testing
 - Context7 MCP: Natural language to code/UI generation
 - Awesome Linters: Curated linter/code quality reference
 - Sequential Thinking MCP: Step-by-step debugging and structured problem solving
 - Memory Bank MCP: Store/retrieve code, logs, and project memory
 - Steel Puppeteer MCP: Browser/emulator automation and screenshotting
 - Knowledge Graph Memory MCP: Persistent memory and relationship management
 - MCP Compass: Discovery and recommendation of MCP servers
 - DuckDuckGo Search MCP: Web search for documentation and solutions

### How to Use MCPs in Rooster App Development
- **Fix Build Errors**: Use context7 and sequential-thinking MCPs to generate/fix Jetpack Compose code and debug errors in files like `MainActivity.kt`.
- **Preview UI**: Use @Preview annotations in Compose, and automate emulator UI tests/screenshots with playwright or steel-puppeteer MCPs.
- **Lint and Format**: Reference awesome-linters and use tools like ktlint for code quality.
- **Store Progress**: Use memory-bank MCP to archive fixed code and build logs for future reference.
- **Validate Data**: Use Back4App dashboard for Parse data, and knowledge-graph-memory MCP for lineage/traceability previews.
- **Find Documentation**: Use duckduckgo-search MCP to quickly search for solutions to errors or implementation questions.
- **Get Recommendations**: Use mcp-compass MCP to discover the best MCP for a given task (e.g., UI prototyping, debugging).

### Example Prompts for AI Agents
- Generate/fix Compose code: `context7` MCP prompt for MainActivity.kt with BottomNavigation and navigation.
- Automate UI tests: `playwright` or `steel-puppeteer` MCP prompt to click tabs and screenshot screens.
- Lint code: Use `ktlint` as referenced by awesome-linters.
- Debug errors: `sequential-thinking` MCP prompt for stepwise build error resolution.
- Store/retrieve code: `memory-bank` MCP prompt to save MainActivity.kt and logs.
- Preview data relationships: `knowledge-graph-memory` MCP prompt for fowl lineage.
- Search for docs: `duckduckgo-search` MCP prompt for Compose navigation errors.
- Get tool recommendations: `mcp-compass` MCP prompt for UI or debugging tasks.
```

```
## [2025-05-23] MCP Servers Integration & AI-Driven Workflow Guidance
```

```plain_text:updates.txt
### MCP Server Integration
- Integrated multiple Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers in `.config/github-copilot/intellij/mcp.json` to enhance development:
 - Playwright MCP: Browser/UI automation and testing
 - Context7 MCP: Natural language to code/UI generation
 - Awesome Linters: Curated linter/code quality reference
 - Sequential Thinking MCP: Step-by-step debugging and structured problem solving
 - Memory Bank MCP: Store/retrieve code, logs, and project memory
 - Steel Puppeteer MCP: Browser/emulator automation and screenshotting
 - Knowledge Graph Memory MCP: Persistent memory and relationship management
 - MCP Compass: Discovery and recommendation of MCP servers
 - DuckDuckGo Search MCP: Web search for documentation and solutions

### How to Use MCPs in Rooster App Development
- **Fix Build Errors**: Use context7 and sequential-thinking MCPs to generate/fix Jetpack Compose code and debug errors in files like `MainActivity.kt`.
- **Preview UI**: Use @Preview annotations in Compose, and automate emulator UI tests/screenshots with playwright or steel-puppeteer MCPs.
- **Lint and Format**: Reference awesome-linters and use tools like ktlint for code quality.
- **Store Progress**: Use memory-bank MCP to archive fixed code and build logs for future reference.
- **Validate Data**: Use Back4App dashboard for Parse data, and knowledge-graph-memory MCP for lineage/traceability previews.
- **Find Documentation**: Use duckduckgo-search MCP to quickly search for solutions to errors or implementation questions.
- **Get Recommendations**: Use mcp-compass MCP to discover the best MCP for a given task (e.g., UI prototyping, debugging).

### Example Prompts for AI Agents
- Generate/fix Compose code: `context7` MCP prompt for MainActivity.kt with BottomNavigation and navigation.
- Automate UI tests: `playwright` or `steel-puppeteer` MCP prompt to click tabs and screenshot screens.
- Lint code: Use `ktlint` as referenced by awesome-linters.
- Debug errors: `sequential-thinking` MCP prompt for stepwise build error resolution.
- Store/retrieve code: `memory-bank` MCP prompt to save MainActivity.kt and logs.
- Preview data relationships: `knowledge-graph-memory` MCP prompt for fowl lineage.
- Search for docs: `duckduckgo-search` MCP prompt for Compose navigation errors.
- Get tool recommendations: `mcp-compass` MCP prompt for UI or debugging tasks.

### Next Steps
- Review `.config/github-copilot/intellij/mcp.json` for available MCP servers and their descriptions.
- Use the mapped prompts and tools above to accelerate development, fix errors, and enable robust previews.
- Continue updating this log after each major feature, config, or workflow change.
```

```kotlin
 }

data class PostData(
 val objectId: String,
 val content: String,
 val username: String,
 val imageUrl: String?,
 val likes: Int,
 val comments: List<String>
)

suspend fun fetchPosts(posts: MutableState<List<PostData>>, isLoading: MutableState<Boolean>, error: MutableState<String?>) {
 isLoading.value = true
 try {
 val query = ParseQuery.getQuery<ParseObject>("Post")
 query.setLimit(20)
 query.orderByDescending("createdAt")
 query.include("user")
 val results = query.find()
 posts.value = results.mapNotNull {
 val content = it.getString("content")
 val user = it.getParseUser("user")?.username
 val image = it.getParseFile("image")?.url
 val likes = it.getInt("likes") ?: 0
 val comments = it.getList<String>("comments") ?: emptyList()
 if (content != null && user != null) {
 PostData(it.objectId, content, user, image, likes, comments)
 } else null
 }
 } catch (e: Exception) {
 error.value = e.message
 } finally {
 isLoading.value = false
 }
}

fun compressImage(context: Context, uri: Uri): ByteArray? {
 return try {
 val inputStream = context.contentResolver.openInputStream(uri)
 val bitmap = BitmapFactory.decodeStream(inputStream)
 val outputStream = ByteArrayOutputStream()
 bitmap.compress(Bitmap.CompressFormat.JPEG, 80, outputStream)
 outputStream.toByteArray()
 } catch (e: Exception) {
 Log.e("ImageCompression", "Error compressing image", e)
 null
 }
}
```

```plain_text:updates.txt
## [2025-05-23] MCP Servers Integration & AI-Driven Workflow Guidance

### MCP Server Integration
- Integrated multiple Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers in `.config/github-copilot/intellij/mcp.json` to enhance development:
 - Playwright MCP: Browser/UI automation and testing
 - Context7 MCP: Natural language to code/UI generation
 - Awesome Linters: Curated linter/code quality reference
 - Sequential Thinking MCP: Step-by-step debugging and structured problem solving
 - Memory Bank MCP: Store/retrieve code, logs, and project memory
 - Steel Puppeteer MCP: Browser/emulator automation and screenshotting
 - Knowledge Graph Memory MCP: Persistent memory and relationship management
 - MCP Compass: Discovery and recommendation of MCP servers
 - DuckDuckGo Search MCP: Web search for documentation and solutions

### How to Use MCPs in Rooster App Development
- **Fix Build Errors**: Use context7 and sequential-thinking MCPs to generate/fix Jetpack Compose code and debug errors in files like `MainActivity.kt`.
- **Preview UI**: Use @Preview annotations in Compose, and automate emulator UI tests/screenshots with playwright or steel-puppeteer MCPs.
- **Lint and Format**: Reference awesome-linters and use tools like ktlint for code quality.
- **Store Progress**: Use memory-bank MCP to archive fixed code and build logs for future reference.
- **Validate Data**: Use Back4App dashboard for Parse data, and knowledge-graph-memory MCP for lineage/traceability previews.
- **Find Documentation**: Use duckduckgo-search MCP to quickly search for solutions to errors or implementation questions.
- **Get Recommendations**: Use mcp-compass MCP to discover the best MCP for a given task (e.g., UI prototyping, debugging).

### Example Prompts for AI Agents
- Generate/fix Compose code: `context7` MCP prompt for MainActivity.kt with BottomNavigation and navigation.
- Automate UI tests: `playwright` or `steel-puppeteer` MCP prompt to click tabs and screenshot screens.
- Lint code: Use `ktlint` as referenced by awesome-linters.
- Debug errors: `sequential-thinking` MCP prompt for stepwise build error resolution.
- Store/retrieve code: `memory-bank` MCP prompt to save MainActivity.kt and logs.
- Preview data relationships: `knowledge-graph-memory` MCP prompt for fowl lineage.
- Search for docs: `duckduckgo-search` MCP prompt for Compose navigation errors.
- Get tool recommendations: `mcp-compass` MCP prompt for UI or debugging tasks.

### Next Steps
- Review `.config/github-copilot/intellij/mcp.json` for available MCP servers and their descriptions.
- Use the mapped prompts and tools above to accelerate development, fix errors, and enable robust previews.
- Continue updating this log after each major feature, config, or workflow change.
```

```kotlin
package com.example.roosterapp

import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.*
import androidx.compose.foundation.lazy.LazyColumn
import androidx.compose.foundation.lazy.items
import androidx.compose.material3.*
import androidx.compose.runtime.*
import androidx.compose.ui.Modifier
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.dp
import com.parse.ParseObject
import com.parse.ParseQuery
import com.parse.ParseUser
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch

@Composable
fun FarmerHomeScreen() {
 val coroutineScope = rememberCoroutineScope()
 val snackbarHostState = remember { SnackbarHostState() }
 var alerts by remember { mutableStateOf(listOf<Alert>()) }
 var products by remember { mutableStateOf(listOf<Product>()) }
 var socialPosts by remember { mutableStateOf(listOf<SocialPost>()) }
 var isLoading by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
 var error by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }

 LaunchedEffect(Unit) {
 fetchAlerts(alerts, isLoading, error)
 fetchProducts(products, isLoading, error)
 fetchSocialPosts(socialPosts, isLoading, error)
 }

 Scaffold(
 snackbarHost = { SnackbarHost(snackbarHostState) }
 ) { innerPadding ->
 Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(innerPadding).padding(16.dp)) {
 Text(text = "Home", style = MaterialTheme.typography.headlineMedium)

 if (isLoading) {
 CircularProgressIndicator(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth())
 return@Column
 }

 LazyColumn {
 // Rankings Section (Static for now)
 item {
 Text(
 text = "Rankings",
 style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium,
 modifier = Modifier.padding(bottom = 8.dp)
 )
 Card(modifier = Modifier.padding(8.dp)) {
 Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(16.dp)) {
 Text(text = "Top Seller: Farmer John", style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyLarge)
 Text(text = "Sales: 150 units")
 }
 }
 }

 // Health Tips Section (Static for now)
 item {
 Text(
 text = "Health Tips",
 style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium,

 )
 Card(modifier = Modifier.padding(8.dp)) {
 Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(16.dp)) {

 }

 }

 // Alerts Section
 item {
 Text(
 text = "Alerts",
 style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium,
 modifier = Modifier.padding(top = 16.dp, bottom = 8.dp)
 )
 }
 items(alerts) { alert ->

 item {

data class Alert(val message: String, val createdAt: String)
data class Product(val title: String, val price: Int)
data class SocialPost(val username: String, val content: String)

suspend fun fetchAlerts(
 alerts: MutableState<List<Alert>>,
 isLoading: MutableState<Boolean>,
 error: MutableState<String?>
) {
 isLoading.value = true
 try {
 val query = ParseQuery.getQuery<ParseObject>("Notification")
 query.whereEqualTo("user", ParseUser.getCurrentUser())
 query.orderByDescending("createdAt")
 query.setLimit(5)

 val results = query.find()
 alerts.value = results.mapNotNull {
 val message = it.getString("message") ?: return@mapNotNull null
 val createdAt = it.createdAt?.toString() ?: return@mapNotNull null
 Alert(message, createdAt)
 }
 } catch (e: Exception) {
 error.value = e.message
 } finally {
 isLoading.value = false
 }
}

suspend fun fetchProducts(
 products: MutableState<List<Product>>,
 isLoading: MutableState<Boolean>,
 error: MutableState<String?>
) {
 isLoading.value = true
 try {
 val query = ParseQuery.getQuery<ParseObject>("Listing")
 query.whereEqualTo("seller", ParseUser.getCurrentUser())
 query.orderByDescending("createdAt")
 query.setLimit(5)

 val results = query.find()
 products.value = results.mapNotNull {
 val title = it.getString("title") ?: return@mapNotNull null
 val price = it.getInt("price") ?: 0
 Product(title, price)
 }
 } catch (e: Exception) {
 error.value = e.message
 } finally {
 isLoading.value = false
 }
}

suspend fun fetchSocialPosts(
 posts: MutableState<List<SocialPost>>,
 isLoading: MutableState<Boolean>,
 error: MutableState<String?>
) {
 isLoading.value = true
 try {
 val query = ParseQuery.getQuery<ParseObject>("Post")
 query.include("user")
 query.orderByDescending("createdAt")
 query.setLimit(5)

 val results = query.find()
 posts.value = results.mapNotNull {
 val user = it.getParseUser("user") ?: return@mapNotNull null
 val username = user.getString("username") ?: return@mapNotNull null
 val content = it.getString("content") ?: return@mapNotNull null
 SocialPost(username, content)
 }
 } catch (e: Exception) {
 error.value = e.message
 } finally {
 isLoading.value = false
 }
}

fun FarmerHomeScreenPreview() {
 FarmerHomeScreen()
}
```
